positions.title: Program Coordinator
positions.description:
Maintain and produce content for program websites and annual reports
Organize and market special program events for the campus and surrounding communities
Manage and reconcile eight departmental budgets

company.name: McCann School of Business and Technology

positions.title: Assistant Registrar
positions.description:
Ensured compliance of incoming student files and maintained current student files
Maintained accuracy of the school’s catalog with respect to changes in programs, regulations, and staffing
Optimized future course offerings in response to student schedule needs and graduation requirements

positions.title: Human Resources and Payroll Administrator
positions.description:
Ensured validity of employee information in the Human Resource Information System to update for new hires, rate changes, and terminations
Maintained employee timesheets to prepare payroll for processing on a bi-weekly basis

positions.title: Receptionist
positions.description:
Demonstrated excellent customer service skills while working with current and potential students
Reviewed and audited the school’s database to produce error-free student records
